name: xauusd-trading-bot-frontend
description: Frontend LIFF app for XAUUSD Trading Bot - User Settings Panel

scripts.start: node -e "const http = require('http'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); http.createServer((req, res) => { res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*'); res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/html; charset=utf-8'); const file = req.url === '/' ? 'liff-enhanced-settings.html' : req.url; const filePath = path.join(__dirname, file); try { res.end(fs.readFileSync(filePath)); } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not Found'); } }).listen(process.env.PORT || 3001); console.log('Frontend running on port', process.env.PORT || 3001); "
